name: The Town Hall at Elbow Height
prompt: Lay an immense continuous horseshoe table across a paved court, with public services built into its thick drawers. People sit on either side to negotiate face to face. A carpenter adds a new leaf when the queue gets long.

name: The Court of Common Weight
prompt: Set a vast level platform on a visible stone fulcrum. Citizens arrange movable benches and counterweights until the floor balances before a debate. The empty space between the two gatherings holds a bright red speaking stool.

name: The Petition Orchard
prompt: Plant black iron trees on a pale civic terrace. Their branches bend under ceramic tokens hung for different public requests. Officials move the heaviest branch onto a rolling trestle and wheel it into the open meeting room.

name: The Public Staircase
prompt: Stack broad coloured stair flights facing in four directions around an empty core. Each landing houses a different civic desk. A small central hoist carries a common ledger between librarians, registrars and the residents waiting on the steps.

name: The Office of Unwanted Gifts
prompt: Arrange open display rooms around a municipal court. Give each room a different present someone received with a polite smile: a loud Christmas jumper on a hanger, a singing fish on its plaque, a spotted tie still in its box, a pair of furry slippers. Set each gift where its shape and colour read from the gallery. At the intake counter a clerk unties the ribbon on the next donation.
